name: Synn
message: 「Morning, Nanaka... Huh? I don't hear Sasami」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe he stayed up late last night」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He's not you--hyup! Here you go, freeloader. Breakfast is ready」

name: Paqy
message: 「I-I want you to step on me more--」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, time to dig into some delicious soba again today」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I smell a festival♪ Onward we march, let's go!」

name: Synn
message: 「You sure love a spectacle, Nanaka. Slurp, slurp, slurp」
Sally is lying flat on her back.
Directly across from her, Sasami lets out a triumphant crow.
Judging by the scattered feathers, it looks like there was some kind of scuffle.

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't tell me, Sally. Did you try to eat Sasami?」

name: Sally
message: 「No way~. I just peeked in for a second, and he pecked me out of nowhere~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha, Sally. Looks like he's already taken a liking to you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So you really are planning to eat him...」

name: Sally
message: 「The Boss explicitly told me not to eat raw meat because it'll upset my stomach!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Ow-ow-ow, stop! I was kidding, I'm sorryyy\s06」
I move Sasami away from Sally.

name: Sally
message: 「Hmph. Do you really think someone like you could impress the refined palate of a 'gourmet' like me? Bleeh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa, a new move: Chicken Feather Barrage」
Hmm. It'd be a problem if the garden got trashed again like with that Demon who showed up before.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right. Nanaka, do we still have any soba left?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally, would you like to stay and have breakfast with us?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you don't want it, you're not getting any」

name: Synn
message: 「Beef bowls are great, sure, but soba is good too~」

name: Synn
message: 「*Sniff, sniff.* Somehow I'm crying along with her\s06」

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh~. So this is what they call soba?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Let's dig in before the noodles get soggy」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You dip the noodles in the broth like this and eat 'em」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha. You don't need to eat in such a rush」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha. Really wakes you up, doesn't it~」

name: Sally
message: 「No more wasabi for me! I'll eat it without dipping sauce」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew, I'm stuffed. Thanks for the meal」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, clean up once you're done eating」
Even Sally-chan helped out without complaining.

name: Sally
message: 「I came to scout out the enemy base, so getting to eat delicious soba is super lucky\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, what are you gonna do now, Sally-chan?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sasami's coming with me, is that okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Student Council activities are on hold until after school, you know~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Sally, what do you usually do?」

name: Sally
message: 「What do I do? Do you have to be doing something just because you're alive?」

name: Sally
message: 「Besides, I don't really remember what I do anyway. Oh, I'll never forget the taste of that soba, though!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That makes me so happy to hear!」

name: Sally
message: 「Huh? I had something to do today, and that's why I went to the Prez's house--」

name: Sally
message: 「Aaah, that's right! I've gotta hurry back and tell the Boss」

name: Synn
message: 「Then come back to the school once classes are over」

name: Sally
message: 「I'll be fine. I'm flying, after all~」
With that, Sally floats softly up and vanishes into the sky.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Looks like she's gonna get caught on a power line」
